x.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `float32`, `float64`.
constraints: x must be one of float32, float64
x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

y.description: A `Tensor` whose dtype is compatible with `x`.
constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

output.description: The element-wise value of the x times y.

constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes
